alice: FYI onboarding QA hit a strange race: when the sampleapp triggers a token refresh at the same time the API returns a 429, we've seen two successful creates for the same logical operation. Minimal logs below.

tom: Can you paste the log snippet?
alice: Sure:
```
2026-02-10T14:05:01Z WARN req=op-41 429 retry_after=0.25s attempt=1
2026-02-10T14:05:01Z INFO auth token refreshed (ttl expired)
2026-02-10T14:05:02Z INFO req=op-41 retry attempt=2 -> 200 created id=pay_live_01
2026-02-10T14:05:02Z INFO req=op-41 processed -> created id=pay_live_02
```
priya: Looks like the retry generated a fresh client request id on the second try, so server couldn't dedupe. The sampleapp currently does `request_id: uuid()` inline which runs per attempt.
tom: Two angles: short-term patch in sampleapp to reuse request id per logical op; medium-term change in SDK to inject an `Idempotency-Key` header by default for POST/PUT/PATCH with opt-out. Also backoff change: current backoff is deterministic-ish and causing retry bunching around token rotation.
alice: Repro rate in our CI harness is ~20% when token TTL is set to 1s. After stashing request_id in retry context the duplicates disappeared in 200 runs.
deploy-bot: CI job payments-onboard #210 finished: 200 runs, 0 duplicates after sampleapp patch.
priya: For the SDK proposal: auto-inject header only when the app hasn't provided one and when endpoint appears mutating. Configs: `sdk.autoIdempotency=true` (opt-out via env `REDWOOD_SDK_AUTOIDEMPOTENCY=false`), `sdk.backoff.strategy=full_jitter`, `sdk.backoff.base_ms=450`. Full jitter reduces clumping: delay = rand(0, base * 2^attempt).
tom: Also add a telemetry flag (boolean) when SDK supplies header so we can monitor adoption without sending keys. Security should review retention/PII risks and logging.
alice: Server side also needs a dedupe TTL per route (eg `safeReplayWindowMs=120000`) so teams can balance duplicate protection vs memory. For payments backend we recommend 5min.
priya: I can open the SDK PR. Plan: implement stable request_id in sampleapp first, then canary the SDK change with the sampleapp using canary. Add e2e that simulates token rotation + single 429 and assert only one recorded side-effect.
tom: Rollout plan: canary SDK to internal sampleapp + 1 external customer sandbox, run nightly stress. If telemetry shows <1% dupes, promote.
alice: Tiny onboarding doc note: "If your flow mutates state, ensure a stable client request id across retries or rely on SDK auto idempotency." I'll patch the quickstart.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy sdk@canary-20260210 started for sampleapp tests.
priya: Tagging eng-security and docs in the PR. I'll include tests and an opt-out switch.

alice: Thanks all - good catch. This was a subtle DX gotcha for new users trying the payments example.
